title.description: Page-level heading text rendered inside the `headingLevel` heading; the runtime API also accepts a template-only snippet.

headingLevel.description: Heading level for the title element. Defaults to `1`.

description.description: Optional supporting text rendered below the title; the runtime API also accepts a template-only snippet.

flush.description:
Draws the header with no rule under it and no padding around it, so its title lines up with the
content beneath it. A page that lays out its own column, such as a page of settings with a
section navigation beside it, uses this; a header across the top of a page keeps its rule.

error.description: A full-page error state shows under this header, so its primary buttons draw as secondary.

statusPlacement.description: Where `status` sits: `inline` beside the title on its first line, or `below` the title.

titleText.description: The title's plain text, for the full-title tooltip when `title` is a snippet.

unsupportedProps.name: breadcrumbs
unsupportedProps.description: Optional breadcrumb navigation rendered above the heading row.

unsupportedProps.name: status
unsupportedProps.description:
The page's status, such as a dot and "Waiting on you". It is a snippet so the page owns the
words and the tone; see `statusPlacement` for where it sits.
